name: Lines of Communication
summary: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity asks you to burn three Highvale documents in the Hinterlands. The request centers on the Highvale Records, Report, and Notes.

sections.title: A Request from Oran
sections.body: In Undercity, Oran Snakewrithe sends you to the Hinterlands with a request concerning three Highvale documents. The Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes are the papers named. Their destruction is the work Oran asks of you.

faq.q: Who asks me to burn the Highvale papers?
faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity asks you to burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.
Oran sends you to the Hinterlands to burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.
Oran names the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

attribution: In-game quest text: Lines of Communication
